# 列出一次就是已定的同一：一个列表恰在其成员之间同一已定时能列出一次，按成员的和与计数于是唯一；否证之律不需要它，求和与计数之律只把它作为局部条件 / Listing once is decided identity: a list can be listed once exactly where identity among its members is decided, and sums and counts once per member are then one number; laws refuting something need nothing, and laws that sum or count need it only as a local condition

## 主张 Claim

一个列表的成员之间同一已定（IdentityDecided l），指其中任何两个成员相同或不同已定。s 把 l 列出一次（ListsOnce s l），指 s 不重复（Distinct）且与 l 成员相同。不重复的列表决定其成员之间的同一（Distinct.identityDecided）；成员之间同一已定时，有一个与之成员相同的不重复列表（listsOnce_of_decided，构造性地由 listOnce 给出）；所以列表恰在成员之间同一已定时能列出一次（listsOnce_iff_decided），而它能列出一次从不能被否证（not_not_listsOnce）。成员相同的不重复列表有同样的每个量的总和与同样的长度（total_eq_of_same、ListsOnce.total_eq、ListsOnce.length_eq）；列表所含关系项的数目（Numbers）唯一（Numbers.unique），恰在成员之间同一已定时存在（numbers_iff_decided）；重复只会增加（Numbers.le_length、ListsOnce.total_le）。处处列出一次时否证某事的律，对该列表不加前提地否证它（not_of_listsOnce）；所以结论是否证的律对任何列出方式的家族成立（Flow.Dissipative.opens_listing、Flow.Dissipative.finite_ceases_listing、Flow.taking_draws_in_listing、Web.generation_ceases_listing、Flow.taking_stops_listing），耗散使每个可枚举的世界归于静止（World.Enumerated、World.Enumerated.rests）。用到这一承诺之处它是局部的：一步被封闭（或围绕一个家族被封闭）恰在有一个跨此步封闭、成员之间同一已定的家族时（Flow.enclosed_iff、Flow.around_iff）；世界有限恰在可枚举且关系项之间同一已定时（World.finite_iff）；耗散就是每个封闭家族按成员读一次时的耗散（Flow.dissipative_iff）；每个普查决定其所列者之间的同一（Listed.identityDecided），任何带同一判定的列出给出普查（Listed.of_listing）。重复并非无害：在 Doubled 中流平衡并耗散，把来到静止的条件列两次的家族是封闭的而没有在其上耗散，其存量不降，列一次则降（Doubled.needs_once）。不加前提。 / Identity among a list's members is decided (IdentityDecided l) where for any two members it is decided whether they are the same. s lists l once (ListsOnce s l) where s is without repetition (Distinct) and has the members of l. A list without repetition decides identity among its members (Distinct.identityDecided); where identity among a list's members is decided, some list without repetition has exactly its members (listsOnce_of_decided, constructively by listOnce); so a list can be listed once exactly where identity among its members is decided (listsOnce_iff_decided), and that it can be is never refuted (not_not_listsOnce). Lists without repetition with the same members have the same total of every quantity and the same length (total_eq_of_same, ListsOnce.total_eq, ListsOnce.length_eq); the number of relata a list holds (Numbers) is one number (Numbers.unique) and exists exactly where identity among its members is decided (numbers_iff_decided); repetition only adds (Numbers.le_length, ListsOnce.total_le). A law refuting something wherever a list is listed once refutes it of the list with no premise (not_of_listsOnce); so the laws whose conclusion is a refutation hold of every family however listed (Flow.Dissipative.opens_listing, Flow.Dissipative.finite_ceases_listing, Flow.taking_draws_in_listing, Web.generation_ceases_listing, Flow.taking_stops_listing), and dissipation brings every enumerated world to rest (World.Enumerated, World.Enumerated.rests). Where the commitment is used it is local: a step is enclosed, or enclosed around a family, exactly where some family closed across it has decided identity among its members (Flow.enclosed_iff, Flow.around_iff); a world is finite exactly where it is enumerated and identity among its relata is decided (World.finite_iff); dissipation is dissipation on every closed family read once per member (Flow.dissipative_iff); every census decides identity among what it lists (Listed.identityDecided), and any listing with identity decided gives a census (Listed.of_listing). Repetition is not harmless: in Doubled the flow balances and dissipates, the family listing twice the condition that comes to stand is closed and not dissipated on, and its stock does not fall, while listed once it falls (Doubled.needs_once). No premise.

## 前提与对应 Hypotheses and correspondence

- 不加前提：listsOnce_iff_decided、numbers_iff_decided、World.finite_iff、Flow.enclosed_iff、Flow.around_iff 与 Flow.dissipative_iff 是双向的，对每个列表、流与世界成立。 / No premise: listsOnce_iff_decided, numbers_iff_decided, World.finite_iff, Flow.enclosed_iff, Flow.around_iff and Flow.dissipative_iff are two-way and hold for every list, flow and world.
- 已定（Decided）是 P58 的：一个命题成立或不成立已给出；不用排中律。 / Decided is P58's: that a proposition holds or fails is given; excluded middle is not used.
- 没有修改任何已有模块：已有定义被证明等价于其重新奠基的形式。 / No existing module is changed: the existing definitions are proved equivalent to their re-founded forms.

P77（工作板），按 Ren 2026-10-12 的“move towards 100%”：零前提计划把每个关系项列出一次、家族不重复（Distinct）列为表示的承诺（(b) 类第 4 项）。像 P58 对可判定性那样，这里找出这一承诺是什么：它就是在求和或计数之处其成员之间同一已定，一个局部条件。清点（inventory）：15 个模块中 169 个声明直接用到 Distinct；30 个不需要任何前提，33 个是按成员求和的局部条件，31 个是计数关系项的局部条件，9 个按出现重新奠基，其余是数、工具或见证。读法（AI 的，待 Ren）：列出一次所承诺的不多于此。见整合文档 §101。 / P77 (work board), following Ren's “move towards 100%” of 12 October 2026: the zero-premise plan lists among the commitments of the representation that each relatum is listed once and families are without repetition (Distinct; class (b), item 4). As P58 did for decidedness, this finds what the commitment is: identity decided among the members where a sum or count is taken, a local condition. Inventory: 169 declarations in 15 modules use Distinct directly; 30 need no premise, 33 are local conditions of a sum once per member, 31 local conditions of a count of relata, 9 are re-founded by occurrence, and the rest are numbers, tools or witnesses. Reading (the AI's, pending Ren): listing once commits to no more than this. See the integration document §101.
